events.text:
{"topic":"app-manual","bytes":2248,"guide":"## USING SLATES FROM YOUR OWN AI — Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, Codex (ChatGPT), the MCP server, the Slates CLI

Your own AI app can drive Slates on this computer through the Slates MCP server: everything the Studio Agent can do, from the chat you already use, on your Slates credits. The desktop app must be running; the AI talks to it on this computer. Connect once in Settings → **AI tools**.

## SETTINGS, ACCOUNT AND CREDITS — Account, usage, AI tools (Studio Agent, Claude, Cursor, Codex, ChatGPT images), Storage and moving projects, Generation logs, sign-in, buying credits

### Settings: AI tools — Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, CLI, any MCP tool (Connect, Copy)
The boxed list **AI tools** has six rows.
| Row | Button | What it does | Agent op |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Claude Desktop** | **Connect** | Adds a `slates` entry to Claude Desktop's config file, keeping a `.bak`; needs Node's `npx` on the PATH | only you |
| **Claude Code** | **Connect** | Runs `claude mcp add slates -s user -- npx -y @slatesvideo/mcp-server` | only you |
| **Cursor** | **Connect** | Adds a `slates` entry to `~/.cursor/mcp.json`, keeping a `.bak` | only you |
| **Codex (ChatGPT)** | **Copy** | Copies `codex mcp add slates -- npx -y @slatesvideo/mcp-server`; the button reads **Copied** for two seconds | only you |
| **Slates CLI** | **Copy** | Copies `npm i -g @slatesvideo/cli` | only you |
| **Any other tool** | **Copy** | Copies `npx -y @slatesvideo/mcp-server` | only you |

**Connect** shows only when the tool is found on this computer; otherwise the row reads **Not installed**. After it works the row reads **Added. Restart it to load Slates**: restart that tool. **Setup guide** under the list opens slates.video/docs/connect-claude. A failure shows under the row name: see Settings: messages you may see (AI tools).

Related sections (ask by heading): Your own AI: connect Claude, Cursor or Codex (set up the MCP) · Settings: AI tools — connect Claude, Cursor or Codex by email link (Send link, Disconnect) · Settings: how to connect Claude, Cursor or Codex to Slates · Studio Agent: model and where it thinks (what runs it, Slates free, ChatGPT plan through Codex, Claude plan through Claude Code, thinking level)"}

**Slates is already connected to this Claude Code session.** I just read your workspace and can see your two projects, **Morning Ritual Coffee** (5 assets) and **Bakery launch** (empty). You don't need to set anything up here.

For reference, or to set it up on another machine:

1. **Open the Slates desktop app and keep it running.** Claude Code talks to the app on your computer, so the app has to be open.
2. In Slates, go to **Settings → AI tools**, find the **Claude Code** row and click **Connect**. That runs:
   ```
   claude mcp add slates -s user -- npx -y @slatesvideo/mcp-server
   ```
   - If the row says **Not installed**, Slates couldn't find Claude Code on that computer. You can run the command above in a terminal yourself. It needs Node.js installed so that `npx` works.
3. When the row reads **Added. Restart it to load Slates**, restart Claude Code.

The **Setup guide** link under that list opens slates.video/docs/connect-claude if you need more help. The same panel has buttons for Claude Desktop, Cursor and Codex.

**Credits:** Anything that creates images or video uses your Slates credits. Before each generation, I'll show you an itemized cost estimate and wait for your OK.

Do you want to start on one of your projects? I can pick up **Morning Ritual Coffee** or start building out **Bakery launch**.
